- Empty quoted values (`""`, `''`)
- Mismatched quotes (`"value'`, `'value"`) — kept as-is
- Single lone quote character

- Quotes in middle of value — not stripped
- Triple quotes

- `\"` inside double quotes — parser doesn't handle escape sequences, documents actual behavior
- Backslashes in paths (both quoted and unquoted)

**Whitespace:**
- Leading whitespace on lines
- Trailing whitespace trimmed from values
- Whitespace-only lines skipped
- Tabs around `=`
- Spaces inside quoted values preserved vs. trimmed from unquoted values

**Special values:**
- Hash/pound sign in values (not treated as inline comment)
- Multiple `=` signs (base64 values)
- Unicode characters and emoji

**Key edge cases:**
- Keys with dots, underscores, numbers
- Duplicate keys (last wins)
- Empty key (`=value`)

- Comments with `=` signs
- Comments with leading whitespace
- `load()` error on missing file
- `load_optional()` with existing file
- Windows `\r\n` line endings
- Completely empty input
- Only comments and blanks
